## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A scenario with two principals modifying the same requirement runs and...

The system SHALL ensure that a scenario with two principals modifying the same requirement runs and records whether a collision was detected at plan time (baseline: not detected).

#### Scenario: A scenario with two principals modifying the same requirement runs and...

WHEN `multiplayer-simulation-harness` is implemented
THEN A scenario with two principals modifying the same requirement runs and records whether a collision was detected at plan time (baseline: not detected).

### Requirement: The memory-store scenario reports a time-blocked-on-dependency metric for...

The system SHALL ensure that the memory-store scenario reports a time-blocked-on-dependency metric for the dependent principal.

#### Scenario: The memory-store scenario reports a time-blocked-on-dependency metric for...

WHEN `multiplayer-simulation-harness` is implemented
THEN The memory-store scenario reports a time-blocked-on-dependency metric for the dependent principal.

### Requirement: Scenarios run in CI without network access to a shared coordinator

The system SHALL ensure that scenarios run in CI without network access to a shared coordinator.

#### Scenario: Scenarios run in CI without network access to a shared coordinator

WHEN `multiplayer-simulation-harness` is implemented
THEN Scenarios run in CI without network access to a shared coordinator.

### Requirement: Scenario tests resolve change paths with change_dir() and pass the OpenSpec...

The system SHALL ensure that scenario tests resolve change paths with change_dir() and pass the OpenSpec path-stability guard test.

#### Scenario: Scenario tests resolve change paths with change_dir() and pass the OpenSpec...

WHEN `multiplayer-simulation-harness` is implemented
THEN Scenario tests resolve change paths with change_dir() and pass the OpenSpec path-stability guard test.
